create_DrawElementsSphere: create a DrawElementsSphere group with coordinates, radii, and optional element or group properties for 3D visualization
create_DrawElementsLine: create a DrawElementsLine group with line coordinates of shape (N, 2, 3) for 3D visualization
create_DrawElementsPoly: create a DrawElementsPoly group with polygon plane coordinates for 3D visualization
create_DrawGroup: create a DrawGroup container from a list of DrawElementsBase groups to manage multiple visualization element groups
update_positions_DrawGroup: update all element positions in a DrawGroup using an axes basis matrix and center offset vector
